name: blackscience-tech-skills
description: Research, evaluation, developer tooling, and document workflow skills.

metadata.description: Research, evaluation, developer tooling, and document workflow skills.

plugins.name: academic-zh-en-translation
plugins.description: Translate academic papers, theses, dissertations, abstracts, literature reviews, methods, results, captions, and reviewer responses between Chinese and English with source-faithful completeness, discipline-appropriate terminology, and target-language academic idiom.

plugins.name: benchmark-builder
plugins.description: Build or audit benchmark tasks, scoring contracts, rubrics, evaluators, review examples, pilot plans, and release policies.

plugins.name: ddd
plugins.description: Make source-code work follow Documentation-Driven Development (DDD) so each human-maintained file begins with an accurate, language-native contract that explains its purpose, system role, public surface, data flow, side effects, and constraints before implementation details.

plugins.name: evo2-opengenome2
plugins.description: Work with Arc Institute's Evo 2 genomic language models and the OpenGenome2 dataset. Use for Evo 2 installation, checkpoint selection, inference, embeddings, generation, scoring, training or fine-tuning; OpenGenome2 downloads, Hugging Face cache inspection, FASTA/JSONL/tar streaming, dataset manifests, preprocessing, sampling, progress checks, and recovery from interrupted large downloads; or whenever a request mentions Evo2, Evo 2, OpenGenome2, arcinstitute/evo2, or arcinstitute/opengenome2.

plugins.name: figure-to-prompt
plugins.description: Inspect published or manuscript figures, map their visual evidence to the surrounding text, and write detailed reconstruction or redesign prompts. Use for figure reverse description, figure-text alignment, and screenshot critique before image generation; not for generating scientific data or vector tracing.

plugins.name: gpt-intervention
plugins.description: Correct recurring GPT work failures by preserving user goals, checking real inputs, reconsidering costly choices, and verifying delivered outcomes. Apply proactively at the start of complex work, before consequential runtime, interface, or distribution changes, when fixes become a patch chain, and before declaring completion. Use proportionately; ordinary local edits need no separate audit ritual.

plugins.name: hpc-operator
plugins.description: Operate and troubleshoot IBM Spectrum LSF batch jobs, job arrays, queues, and execution hosts.

plugins.name: latex-to-word
plugins.description: Convert LaTeX files to Word with a deterministic preprocessing script and pandoc.

plugins.name: modern-python-style
plugins.description: Enforce modern Python 3.10+ syntax, static typing discipline, and anti-ceremony code style with deterministic checks.

plugins.name: nix
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug Nix expressions, flakes, NixOS/Home Manager/nix-darwin modules, overlays, and derivations. Use for *.nix files; Nix evaluation or build failures; package, app, devShell, and system outputs; or nix build/run/develop/flake/config commands.

plugins.name: overengineering
plugins.description: Reduce avoidable implementation, test, specification, and collaboration costs under the same real requirements.

plugins.name: paper-reviewer
plugins.description: Review academic papers (PDF/LaTeX/Markdown) with venue-calibrated 1-10 scoring, a ScholarEval-inspired dimension pass, structured peer-review JSON (NeurIPS-style fields), and concise actionable feedback. Use for comprehensive, targeted, or comparative paper evaluation while keeping output bounded and evidence-linked.

plugins.name: paper-visualizer
plugins.description: Route publication-grade visualization tasks by chart family and execute manuscript-facing plot or diagram workflows with packaged agents, shared generators, style guides, and inspectable run artifacts.

plugins.name: paper-writer
plugins.description: Draft or revise scientific papers from experiment artifacts; generate LaTeX scaffolds for conference papers, ICBINB, Molecular Plant, Plant Communications, Bioinformatics Application Notes, or SoftwareX; repair manuscript-local citations; and audit figure-caption-reference consistency. Use for research papers, technical reports, negative-results papers, journal drafts, bibliography repair, or figure QA. Keep claims grounded in supplied evidence. When evidence is missing, recommend the smallest decisive experiment and run lightweight analyses when local artifacts permit. Route Zotero library management and collection export to zotero.

plugins.name: raster-to-vector
plugins.description: Convert raster architecture diagrams, screenshots, flowcharts, UI diagrams, scanned figures, charts, and rendered PDF pages into presentation-ready editable SVG. Use PP-OCR text geometry, local segmentation, CV primitives, optional image understanding, agent-provided icon replacements, and per-element fallback tracing; never ship a final full-canvas embedded PNG as vectorization.

plugins.name: research-idea
plugins.description: Generate, validate, novelty-check, triage, and reposition research ideas.

plugins.name: skill-manager
plugins.description: Review existing skills for useful guidance, trigger scope, overlapping responsibilities, and maintenance cost.

plugins.name: typst
plugins.description: Draft, convert, debug, and validate Typst documents.

plugins.name: zotero
plugins.description: Capture (Zotero Connector), manage, search, and export Zotero libraries and collection-scoped citations using Zotero desktop + Better BibTeX, the Zotero Web API, a local Zotero data directory, or user-provided export files.
